ROTARY CLUB OF MUMBAI MULUND EAST
Project Report – Distribution of Gifts to Street Children

Date: 17th October 2026
Venue: Talaopali Market, Thane West
Beneficiaries: 30 Girls

On the auspicious 7th Day of Navratri, our club brought smiles to 30 young girls by distributing cute bags and bananas, generously sponsored by President Rtn. Suyash Tripathi.

The children’s happy faces and innocent smiles made the morning truly heartwarming. ❤️ Sometimes, the smallest gestures leave the biggest memories. We celebrated Navratri by spreading love, kindness and hope.

Members Present:
* President Rtn. Suyash Tripathi
* Secretary Rtn. Shaline Serpes
* Rtn. Ujwala
* Rtn. Shilpa
Small gifts, priceless smiles, and hearts filled with happiness.
